name: Pilibhit
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 settlement point; not shifted and not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Pilibhit District Administration land-record page identifies the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh service as the computerized land-record interface for all state tehsils. The official UP Revenue Board page identifies Bhulekh/Bhunaksha (भू-नक्शा / शजरा) as the public route for village maps and gata boundaries. This establishes local district service custody and a state cadastral-map route, not citywide parcel completeness.
technicalBlocker: The official UP Bhunaksha application exposed anonymous metadata and map methods, but the bounded exact-point lookup for the preserved WUP point returned an empty object and no safe ID-plus-complete-polygon feature response was obtained. Current service schema/CRS for a returned parcel was therefore not verified. No login, credential, token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe record request was used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Pilibhit District Administration land-record custody, Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh/Bhunaksha public services, UP cadastral-map digitization dashboard, and DILRMP reporting.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous district/tehsil/village metadata and a public map endpoint were verified; no anonymous complete parcel polygon feature was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved unchanged. A public UP Bhunaksha parcel layer exists in the viewer, but returned-feature schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, urban-village mapping, exact-point coverage, and citywide completeness remain unverified. An empty exact-point response, map extent limitation, timeout, or unusable UI is not treated as cadastral absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently validate a first-party anonymous Pilibhit-area village map request that returns a safe native parcel ID and complete polygon before any adapter qualification; keep runtime held.
